name_zh: 斐济/气候/小岛屿国家：气候生存外交与蓝色经济
name_en: Fiji/Climate/Small Island State: Climate Survival Diplomacy & Blue Economy
description_zh: 斐济 330+ 岛屿/维提岛/瓦努阿岛/巴马拉马/1987/2000/2006 三次政变/姆拜尼马拉马 (1954-) 2006 政变/2014 选举/气候变化/海平面上升/珊瑚白化/气候难民/蓝色经济/海洋治理/太平洋岛国论坛/博拉/格拉斯哥/联合国气候谈判领袖。体现 M204 气候生存外交 — 以"海平面即生存红线+蓝色经济+气候正义+太平洋团结"四位一体，在沉岛威胁/政变循环/大国博弈/资源有限四重约束中构建小岛屿国家生存主权。
description_en: Fiji 330+ islands/Viti Levu/Vanua Levu/Bainimarama (1954-) 2006 coup/2014 election/climate change/sea level rise/coral bleaching/climate refugees/blue economy/ocean governance/Pacific Islands Forum/COP26/Glasgow/UN climate negotiations leader. Exemplifies M204 Climate Survival Diplomacy — quaternity of 'sea level as survival redline + blue economy + climate justice + Pacific solidarity' building small island state survival sovereignty amid quadruple constraints of sinking threat/coup cycles/great power games/limited resources.
reason_zh: 斐济非单纯岛国，而是"海平面红线+蓝色经济+气候正义"三位一体生存主体。海平面上升威胁领土生存，蓝色经济(渔业/旅游/海底矿产/碳汇)创造替代生计，气候正义在国际谈判争取资金/技术/损失损害基金。M204 区隔于 M178 极地气候(极地)、M188 山地生态(乞力马扎罗)、M203 万部落(巴新)，核心在于"海平面即主权红线+蓝色经济即生存替代+气候正义即外交武器"的小岛屿国家生存范式。
reason_en: Fiji not mere island state but 'sea level redline + blue economy + climate justice' trinity survival subject. Sea level rise threatens territorial survival, blue economy (fisheries/tourism/seabed minerals/carbon sinks) creates alternative livelihoods, climate justice fights for finance/technology/loss & damage fund in international negotiations. M204 distinct from M178 Polar Climate (polar), M188 Mountain Ecology (Kilimanjaro), M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), core: 'sea level as sovereignty redline + blue economy as survival alternative + climate justice as diplomatic weapon' small island state survival paradigm.

Blue economy & ocean governance: EEZ 1.3M km2/tuna/tourism/deep sea minerals/coral farming/blue carbon/ocean spatial planning/sustainable fisheries/MPAs
